mapper.select: select user_id from sys_user where user_id=#{userId} and status='0' and del_flag='0' for update

select m.perms from sys_user_role ur inner join sys_role r on r.role_id=ur.role_id and r.status='0' and r.del_flag='0' inner join sys_role_menu rm on rm.role_id=r.role_id inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id=rm.menu_id and m.status='0' where ur.user_id=#{userId} order by r.role_id,m.menu_id for update
